laterStaffCaseScope: Upstream omitted physical staff is separately labeled; tests robustness of final detected staff, not a correct full staff inventory.
negativeOwnershipRule: All other wedges/ornaments are authored as non-final-staff music; only the final staff local notes belong to its part. Identical pixels with different source-defined musical/footer provenance are a deliberate identifiability challenge, not evidence that all wedges in real scores are footers.
sourceMaskRule: Target masks authored before analysis; no detector-derived boxes.
timing: Eight serial baseline calls then eight candidate calls per case; small-fixture observation, not production benchmark.
